Symptoms vary widely by person and how much alcohol was consumed.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF11NMuYST2C5mFsRFjR4Kb1QgIwCbpowO_BppGVAnSoqWgAbAtUqqdSp-N8bupgOzM1rE8ZLiByTueLpUxSIZsnyYh9dHAhMPkSO4nOajVtPPmky4YWV5NYgInq37ImSnOKod8CrB37lHqqqX9LbNPczuavs8eZUJW1Kl0QVJCCP4iJ2TYs4buh9VcPE)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXXK9RMx863G-GUeCCZ8zHwUQLasTJAg42a-Iiwiqr-bsxHlW3scMPNPjxfY5K7udr3aAM2Hanmq8NPCoxKqyASUCIMzkvqG7neW-qzwy3C-Cx9AI5AQDkaR1YSQ7L2pTtkgCbyn_xHhhhZOCMYYqbcBkGcQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF15HkKOBPba4ZmEsqu7MWswFeANIpH6jTthuPgNRVixm3vkwDFwhyZHshlBgJchbamC4xmEUkla_nOI-boquVJlCF_5xMq6NJvCJjtU3RWvhBbFE0ZrQ9yxYi3P-J_MWuOA3XQH8UX6Xv4U4IDaPF8LmHXAHsPPMoIuVK_itXOQYorQz_Tff2l20vZJbL)

### Physical Symptoms

- **Headache and body aches:** Throbbing head pain, muscle soreness, and general weakness.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF15HkKOBPba4ZmEsqu7MWswFeANIpH6jTthuPgNRVixm3vkwDFwhyZHshlBgJchbamC4xmEUkla_nOI-boquVJlCF_5xMq6NJvCJjtU3RWvhBbFE0ZrQ9yxYi3P-J_MWuOA3XQH8UX6Xv4U4IDaPF8LmHXAHsPPMoIuVK_itXOQYorQz_Tff2l20vZJbL)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF11NMuYST2C5mFsRFjR4Kb1QgIwCbpowO_BppGVAnSoqWgAbAtUqqdSp-N8bupgOzM1rE8ZLiByTueLpUxSIZsnyYh9dHAhMPkSO4nOajVtPPmky4YWV5NYgInq37ImSnOKod8CrB37lHqqqX9LbNPczuavs8eZUJW1Kl0QVJCCP4iJ2TYs4buh9VcPE)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF13PbcakqgwzE4vR_smSjk9jGh6dRc5aBdKD2FKHi_87xE5rM32-5-AlYa_4Bh4lR3LgsRhj3yhjf7ZoyVOuawg0a3pKEzPPABNzcVZRLllCQLSSjVDOvWj5-zDbwRoSnQmoZhZZteISn-LbYYvYh1y843_jl3nnFwjFhcBo)
- **Dehydration:** Extreme thirst, dry mouth, and lightheadedness or dizziness.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF14ncyL-Nf6u-4-y-tCa9iRQsnehD283csh997zojr-cWC7eQdj4SOQq3voKaZTy7rDuq45g4Oq4akTCZh3fHHCb9a8jcISjCjxPb-yBue6hinoWIX9YNBU2X5AEj0Qt0t3hTiQmzlb4gNas9H6o0ZNXFrbP3YeXfcPST71bKjA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF11NMuYST2C5mFsRFjR4Kb1QgIwCbpowO_BppGVAnSoqWgAbAtUqqdSp-N8bupgOzM1rE8ZLiByTueLpUxSIZsnyYh9dHAhMPkSO4nOajVtPPmky4YWV5NYgInq37ImSnOKod8CrB37lHqqqX9LbNPczuavs8eZUJW1Kl0QVJCCP4iJ2TYs4buh9VcPE)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXMO-ViCIdRzbw_ODYwsBm9gTvDmG80alYKZz3Ier2OiLlZ4OU_EOCAIjjM9eo0GM8b64j_025Xgs8zINJOhDMYHOjzT0X_PJ-FasekFqQTQ6y3ojifReLn_WEW9i2CjgWteQjuAqPr526JZI)
- **Fatigue and poor sleep:** Tiredness, grogginess, and disrupted or unrefreshing sleep.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF11NMuYST2C5mFsRFjR4Kb1QgIwCbpowO_BppGVAnSoqWgAbAtUqqdSp-N8bupgOzM1rE8ZLiByTueLpUxSIZsnyYh9dHAhMPkSO4nOajVtPPmky4YWV5NYgInq37ImSnOKod8CrB37lHqqqX9LbNPczuavs8eZUJW1Kl0QVJCCP4iJ2TYs4buh9VcPE)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXuoyuVt0jYnGF2_3TkdEKJcF5T9R-Ui4ytZsgTkt_ILpl9KouKaQmLLNNmnaxbf49M_aSnX7rOQS4GXxIU_9qBOyB_Epq8WepdItOZ5R8dXq3NcCiS5zvilmKTyxx3ELIHBWIAaE)
- **Stomach upset:** Nausea, vomiting, stomach pain or cramps, and reduced appetite.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF1x8S3Wnut3rp5La0GvZfONYB_jWG9k6mCB16qnDvCW7r6-cmlVnQuKjijjueliL2ulbGp1tYJqzxy65qSBjj_PKee1POJ6WUSdosddPoK3QYj_ejjT-TyTJthQtE2_vraovbyuJmYmGaaVxiEfNqYvGsMtgfOG_oJcEkw_C3Hw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF11NMuYST2C5mFsRFjR4Kb1QgIwCbpowO_BppGVAnSoqWgAbAtUqqdSp-N8bupgOzM1rE8ZLiByTueLpUxSIZsnyYh9dHAhMPkSO4nOajVtPPmky4YWV5NYgInq37ImSnOKod8CrB37lHqqqX9LbNPczuavs8eZUJW1Kl0QVJCCP4iJ2TYs4buh9VcPE)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXMO-ViCIdRzbw_ODYwsBm9gTvDmG80alYKZz3Ier2OiLlZ4OU_EOCAIjjM9eo0GM8b64j_025Xgs8zINJOhDMYHOjzT0X_PJ-FasekFqQTQ6y3ojifReLn_WEW9i2CjgWteQjuAqPr526JZI)
- **Sensory sensitivity:** Heightened sensitivity to bright light and loud sounds.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF11NMuYST2C5mFsRFjR4Kb1QgIwCbpowO_BppGVAnSoqWgAbAtUqqdSp-N8bupgOzM1rE8ZLiByTueLpUxSIZsnyYh9dHAhMPkSO4nOajVtPPmky4YWV5NYgInq37ImSnOKod8CrB37lHqqqX9LbNPczuavs8eZUJW1Kl0QVJCCP4iJ2TYs4buh9VcPE)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF14ncyL-Nf6u-4-y-tCa9iRQsnehD283csh997zojr-cWC7eQdj4SOQq3voKaZTy7rDuq45g4Oq4akTCZh3fHHCb9a8jcISjCjxPb-yBue6hinoWIX9YNBU2X5AEj0Qt0t3hTiQmzlb4gNas9H6o0ZNXFrbP3YeXfcPST71bKjA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF13PbcakqgwzE4vR_smSjk9jGh6dRc5aBdKD2FKHi_87xE5rM32-5-AlYa_4Bh4lR3LgsRhj3yhjf7ZoyVOuawg0a3pKEzPPABNzcVZRLllCQLSSjVDOvWj5-zDbwRoSnQmoZhZZteISn-LbYYvYh1y843_jl3nnFwjFhcBo)
- **Autonomic signs:** Sweating, shakiness or tremors, and a fast heartbeat.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF11NMuYST2C5mFsRFjR4Kb1QgIwCbpowO_BppGVAnSoqWgAbAtUqqdSp-N8bupgOzM1rE8ZLiByTueLpUxSIZsnyYh9dHAhMPkSO4nOajVtPPmky4YWV5NYgInq37ImSnOKod8CrB37lHqqqX9LbNPczuavs8eZUJW1Kl0QVJCCP4iJ2TYs4buh9VcPE)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF15HkKOBPba4ZmEsqu7MWswFeANIpH6jTthuPgNRVixm3vkwDFwhyZHshlBgJchbamC4xmEUkla_nOI-boquVJlCF_5xMq6NJvCJjtU3RWvhBbFE0ZrQ9yxYi3P-J_MWuOA3XQH8UX6Xv4U4IDaPF8LmHXAHsPPMoIuVK_itXOQYorQz_Tff2l20vZJbL)

### Mental and Mood Symptoms

- **Thinking trouble:** Difficulty concentrating, memory issues, or brain fog.
- **Mood shifts:** Increased anxiety, irritability, low mood, or depression.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF17nLq7tWde3Au1PF6UVIZOtM4zjJAV4XESCBHHj6NdYj6vdHpmGYWs131F3Y-JOtc38f3vHQgrbQkrBWm_6GSi_gdS90Qb6xhf5FqIFIzgnrx7yAcZ1fn4_2uRMT5f7PE1ddueC0xw1idOfJHlMwE3VLvHosvgCBOhlDAw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXMO-ViCIdRzbw_ODYwsBm9gTvDmG80alYKZz3Ier2OiLlZ4OU_EOCAIjjM9eo0GM8b64j_025Xgs8zINJOhDMYHOjzT0X_PJ-FasekFqQTQ6y3ojifReLn_WEW9i2CjgWteQjuAqPr526JZI)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF14ncyL-Nf6u-4-y-tCa9iRQsnehD283csh997zojr-cWC7eQdj4SOQq3voKaZTy7rDuq45g4Oq4akTCZh3fHHCb9a8jcISjCjxPb-yBue6hinoWIX9YNBU2X5AEj0Qt0t3hTiQmzlb4gNas9H6o0ZNXFrbP3YeXfcPST71bKjA)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX3mVi9cQyoxQ1Wcl_nzYEpDN0-uBb0DUqvl9KqxlSU4JWdYMC1WcgpCE3ClO-7u6tq0awG46MepnaIUb1eb0Yt0pjBW4ayeh2kMvIcXagEQIYgtnglzHqXLmj9hEVTUDd6yn2mCtW)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF15HkKOBPba4ZmEsqu7MWswFeANIpH6jTthuPgNRVixm3vkwDFwhyZHshlBgJchbamC4xmEUkla_nOI-boquVJlCF_5xMq6NJvCJjtU3RWvhBbFE0ZrQ9yxYi3P-J_MWuOA3XQH8UX6Xv4U4IDaPF8LmHXAHsPPMoIuVK_itXOQYorQz_Tff2l20vZJbL)[[6]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF1x8S3Wnut3rp5La0GvZfONYB_jWG9k6mCB16qnDvCW7r6-cmlVnQuKjijjueliL2ulbGp1tYJqzxy65qSBjj_PKee1POJ6WUSdosddPoK3QYj_ejjT-TyTJthQtE2_vraovbyuJmYmGaaVxiEfNqYvGsMtgfOG_oJcEkw_C3Hw)

### When to Seek Emergency Care
Severe symptoms—such as passing out and not waking up, slow or irregular breathing, seizures, or confusion that does not clear—can signal alcohol poisoning. Call emergency services right away if these occur.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF11NMuYST2C5mFsRFjR4Kb1QgIwCbpowO_BppGVAnSoqWgAbAtUqqdSp-N8bupgOzM1rE8ZLiByTueLpUxSIZsnyYh9dHAhMPkSO4nOajVtPPmky4YWV5NYgInq37ImSnOKod8CrB37lHqqqX9LbNPczuavs8eZUJW1Kl0QVJCCP4iJ2TYs4buh9VcPE)For more details, see the [Mayo Clinic](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF11NMuYST2C5mFsRFjR4Kb1QgIwCbpowO_BppGVAnSoqWgAbAtUqqdSp-N8bupgOzM1rE8ZLiByTueLpUxSIZsnyYh9dHAhMPkSO4nOajVtPPmky4YWV5NYgInq37ImSnOKod8CrB37lHqqqX9LbNPczuavs8eZUJW1Kl0QVJCCP4iJ2TYs4buh9VcPE) hangover guide or the [Cleveland Clinic](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXXK9RMx863G-GUeCCZ8zHwUQLasTJAg42a-Iiwiqr-bsxHlW3scMPNPjxfY5K7udr3aAM2Hanmq8NPCoxKqyASUCIMzkvqG7neW-qzwy3C-Cx9AI5AQDkaR1YSQ7L2pTtkgCbyn_xHhhhZOCMYYqbcBkGcQ) overview on hangover causes and recovery.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXXK9RMx863G-GUeCCZ8zHwUQLasTJAg42a-Iiwiqr-bsxHlW3scMPNPjxfY5K7udr3aAM2Hanmq8NPCoxKqyASUCIMzkvqG7neW-qzwy3C-Cx9AI5AQDkaR1YSQ7L2pTtkgCbyn_xHhhhZOCMYYqbcBkGcQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF11NMuYST2C5mFsRFjR4Kb1QgIwCbpowO_BppGVAnSoqWgAbAtUqqdSp-N8bupgOzM1rE8ZLiByTueLpUxSIZsnyYh9dHAhMPkSO4nOajVtPPmky4YWV5NYgInq37ImSnOKod8CrB37lHqqqX9LbNPczuavs8eZUJW1Kl0QVJCCP4iJ2TYs4buh9VcPE)Are you asking for yourself or someone else right now? items.text: Headache and body aches: Throbbing head pain, muscle soreness, and general weakness. Dehydration: Extreme thirst, dry mouth, and lightheadedness or dizziness. Fatigue and poor sleep: Tiredness, grogginess, and disrupted or unrefreshing sleep. Stomach upset: Nausea, vomiting, stomach pain or cramps, and reduced appetite. Sensory sensitivity: Heightened sensitivity to bright light and loud sounds. Autonomic signs: Sweating, shakiness or tremors, and a fast heartbeat.
